en:
Good timing!
I was just thinking about you.

Could it be...that you figured
out what my talent is!?

Haha, no, I guess that
couldn't be it...
Maybe you're here to ask me out...
Hm? How can I help you?

I was looking for you.
Want to spend some time with me?
Spend time together
Never mind
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>What would you like to do with Rantaro?
Spend time together
Go on a date
Never mind
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>What would you like to do with Rantaro?

Well, if you're gonna spend time with someone,
it's better if it's someone you get along with.
I'm glad. I feel the same way.

<CLT=cltMIND>Rantaro and I talked about
our common interests.

I wonder when I'm going to
remember what my talent is...

At random times, I feel like I'm just about
to remember... Like now, for instance.

<CLT=cltMIND>Rantaro and I talked about
his talent.

Hey, it's alright with me if you don't
wanna talk about anything in particular.

I'm just happy that you wanted
to spend time with me. That's sweet.

I would be upset if you only came to
me when you wanted something.

<CLT=cltMIND>Rantaro and I spent some
time relaxing, doing nothing...
Hm? Why was I looking for you...?
...I totally forgot. Ha.

Maybe I'll keep losing my memory until
I get full blown amnesia or something.

...Sorry, guess that's not
that funny.

<CLT=cltMIND>Rantaro chuckled, and I laughed back,
but I could still sense the tension there.
<CLT=cltMIND>Rantaro and I grew a little closer today.
